modules.module_title: Inspect and Prepare Components for Assembly

pcs.pc_description: Inspect vehicle components for quality and completeness
Prepare components for assembly by cleaning, lubricating, and organizing as needed
Verify that all necessary parts and materials are available for assembly

modules.module_title: Perform Vehicle pre-assembly activities

pcs.pc_description: check and clean the assembling equipment of any dust and impurities
fill CLRI (Clean, lubricate, retighten & inspection) check sheet and report to the supervisor about any abnormalities identified and action taken to resolve them
setup the equipment required as per the selected assembling method
• ensure that the right programme is selected in case of robotic assembly method as defined • in the SOP
lift the auto component manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the designated slot/space as indicated in the drawing/work instructions
inspect and mark the defects if any, such as in paint, dents, grooves, cracks, rough edges etc. on the physical body of the auto component
check all the semi-precision mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic and electrical parts in the auto components by using the correct methodology as indicated in the Work Instructions/SOPs
check adhesion of roof-lining, insulation material, roof-rail etc. of the auto component

modules.module_title: Conduct the assembly operation

pcs.pc_description: perform assembly operation and assemble the safety parts i.e. bearings, shafts etc., electrical semi-precision parts such as electric wire harness, Electronic Control Unit (ECU), automatic lock system, fuel injection system and other similar parts

perform installation of the Oil and Lube systems by placing and fitting the funnel, filters, hose pipes, glands, sockets, suction guns and regulator valves as prescribed in the Work Instructions/ SOPs/Control Plans
carry out sealing of the required areas to prevent any leakage of water/air etc. during the usage of the component
carry out labeling on the auto components specifying the information related to assembly process and quality norms followed

modules.module_title: Conduct the post-assembly operations

pcs.pc_description: apply appropriate lubricant on the component as per manufacturer's specifications
check and confirm that water, diesel or petrol, brake oil, gear oil, engine oil etc. are filled as per the required volume and type
check the assembled auto components as per the control plan, work instructions for product quality
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations

modules.module_title: Inspect the machined components and assembled products to ensure they meet the required specifications

pcs.pc_description: Develop and implement quality control procedures to inspect machined components and assembled products, ensuring they meet the specified tolerances, dimensions, and surface finishes.

Apply non-destructive testing techniques, like magnetic particle inspection, dye penetrant testing, or ultrasonic testing, to detect defects or anomalies in the machined components without damaging them
Maintain accurate records of inspection results, including measurements, defects found, and corrective actions taken, to ensure traceability and compliance with quality standards.

modules.module_title: Develop appropriate packaging designs that protect the products from potential damages

pcs.pc_description: Identify potential hazards and damages that the product may face during transit, such as vibrations, shocks, temperature fluctuations, and humidity changes, and design packaging to mitigate these risks.
Choose appropriate packaging materials based on factors like cost, availability, environmental impact, and performance, such as corrugated cardboard, foam, bubble wrap, or plastic films.
Develop packaging designs that effectively protect the product from potential damages
Arrange the product within the packaging to minimize movement and prevent damage during transportation.

modules.module_title: Carefully pack the machined components or assembled products using the selected materials

pcs.pc_description: Evaluate the size, shape, weight, and fragility of the machined components or assembled products to determine the appropriate packaging materials and methods.
Choose suitable packaging materials, such as corrugated cardboard, foam, bubble wrap, or protective films, based on the product's requirements
Arrange the components or products within the packaging in a manner that ensures even distribution of forces, minimizes contact between parts
Securely close and seal the packaging, using appropriate methods like taping, strapping, or adhesives, to ensure the contents remain protected during transit and storage

pcs.pc_description: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation related to regulatory compliance, including certificates of conformity, technical specifications, and safety manuals
Implement and maintain a robust QMS that ensures consistent quality and compliance across all stages of production
Perform necessary tests and obtain relevant certifications to demonstrate that the products meet the required safety, environmental, and performance standards

modules.module_title: Conduct a pre-operation inspection of the forklift

pcs.pc_description: examine the forklift's exterior, including the body, forks, tires, and undercarriage, for any visible damage, wear, or signs of corrosion
Verify the appropriate fluid levels, such as engine oil, coolant, hydraulic fluid, and fuel, ensuring they are within the recommended range.
Verify the proper functioning of safety features, such as seatbelts, backup alarms, and load backrests

modules.module_title: Safely operate the forklift to transport materials

pcs.pc_description: Conduct a thorough inspection of the forklift before starting any operation. Check tire pressure, fluid levels, brakes, steering, and safety features to ensure the forklift is in good working condition
Put on necessary safety gear, such as a hard hat, safety shoes, high-visibility vest, and safety glasses, to protect yourself during operation
Adhere to safety protocols, such as maintaining a safe speed, using warning signals, and following designated routes within the workplace
Determine the most efficient and safest route to transport materials, considering factors like aisle width, obstacles, and other equipment or personnel in the area

modules.module_title: Perform routine maintenance tasks

pcs.pc_description: Conduct a daily inspection of the forklift, checking tires, fluids, brakes, steering, and safety features to ensure it is in good working condition
Monitor and maintain proper fluid levels, including engine oil, coolant, brake fluid, and hydraulic fluid
ensure electric forklifts are charged and batteries are in good condition. Replace or maintain batteries as required and follow the manufacturer's guidelines for charging cycles.
